name: subtract
description: Subtracts two numbers and produces a result. The numbers must have type float or int and the result will be float or int type.
syntax_line: subtract {subtrahend} from {minuend} and store result in {subtractResult}

id_1.description: Subtrahend must be a whole number or float

invalidValues.description: A string is provided as subtrahend

id_2.description: Minuend must be a whole number or float

invalidValues.description: A string is provided as minuend
